name: Necros
noteEs: Uno de los creators de high elo más reconocidos de Marvel Rivals, conocido por su juego de Spider-Man y dive duelists en el tope de la ladder. Su contenido es competitivo: lecturas del meta, tier lists colaborativas donde varios pros rankean a cada héroe por temporada, y gameplay de rango Celestial/Eternity. Para jugadores intermedios y avanzados que quieren entender el meta desde la perspectiva de quienes lo juegan al más alto nivel.
noteEn: One of the most recognized high-elo Marvel Rivals creators, known for his Spider-Man and dive-duelist play at the top of the ladder. His content is competitive: meta reads, collaborative tier lists where several pros rank every hero each season, and Celestial/Eternity-rank gameplay. For intermediate and advanced players who want to understand the meta from the perspective of those playing it at the highest level.
highlightsEs: Tier lists colaborativas 'Rank EVERY HERO' por temporada con otros top players
Gameplay de Spider-Man y dive duelists en high elo
Streams diarios en Twitch además del canal de YouTube
Presencia frecuente en los debates de meta de la comunidad competitiva
highlightsEn: Collaborative 'Rank EVERY HERO' season tier lists with other top players
Daily Twitch streams alongside the YouTube channel
Frequent presence in the competitive community's meta debates
